summary: Explains assemble's mode option, recommending quoted octal strings or symbolic modes and describing defaults, plus the owner option for file ownership.
questions: Why should I quote file modes like '0644' in Ansible?
What permissions does the assembled file get if I don't set mode?
Can I use symbolic modes like u=rw,g=r?
How do I set the owner of the output file?

answer_card.title: assemble mode and owner
answer_card.answer_md:
`mode`: quote octal values (`'644'`, `'1777'`) or use symbolic (`u=rw,g=r,o=r`). Unquoted numbers without a leading zero become decimal and give wrong permissions. If unset, new files get the umask default and existing files keep their mode.

`owner`: user owner (numeric = UID).
